skill_name: Describe the events leading up to World War I.
workflow: The events leading up to World War I began with rising tensions between the nations of Europe. These tensions increased when the countries of the Triple Entente (Britain, France, Russia) formed a military alliance and the countries of the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy) formed their own military alliance.
